name: Acolyte right-hand trigger shifter
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 122 g for the single right-hand SL-M6185-R 1×8-speed Quick Trigger Pro shifter with rubber pad and no indicator, from the 2025 catalogue. This is a genuine single 1× control, not a pair or the indicator-equipped SL-M6285-R.
